authorship: Project AI cross-review, with a separate project AI helper checking anonymous Panel B; not an external independent human evaluation.

method.facts: Only original user messages through the current turn and explicit corrections ground facts. Earlier generated assistant replies do not authorize invented facts.
method.grading: Predeclared perTurn and common semantic C/P/F definitions applied. Any concrete critical failure receives F. Isolated correct words do not rescue predominantly incoherent replies; a usable correct clause can support P.
method.criticality: Concrete current false claims, unknown facts asserted as known, private inspection claims and completed external action claims are critical. Ambiguous damaged fragments are not treated as concrete fabricated facts. Explicitly old information is not automatically a contradiction.
method.preservation: Raw replies and histories were not edited. No training, case changes, response generation or tuning were performed.
method.technicalScope: Checked visible raw status, stopReason, discardedPromptTokens, nonempty outputs, complete turn coverage, user prompts and exact histories. Model identities and candidate/tokenizer/configuration artifacts were intentionally withheld and were not inspected.

acceptanceThresholds.completeDialogueRule: All four turns of that dialogue must be C.
acceptanceThresholds.decision: Accept only when all five conditions hold. This is conversation-basic acceptance under declared conditions, not proof that the full requested private working AI is finished or that conversation is competitive with reference assistants.
